app.name: NSCAS
app.tagline: Online measurement of occupational safety and health (OSH) culture maturity

common.resultDisclaimer: These results are an internal measurement and diagnosis that use the Safety Culture Ladder framework as a reference. They are not a Safety Culture Ladder certificate or an official Safety Culture Ladder statement issued by a certification body recognised by NEN.
common.draftBanner: Draft, not yet confirmed by the assessor panel meeting

home.intro: This application is under construction. The assessment console, respondent survey, and reports will be available in later phases.

health.title: System status
health.description: Connection checks for the database and object storage.
health.overallError: One or more components cannot be reached
health.hint: If a component fails, make sure the development services are running with docker compose up -d and that the .env file has been filled in according to .env.example.

login.title: Sign in to NSCAS
login.description: Use your account email and password.
login.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Enter both your email and password.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect. Check them and try again. The account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 failed attempts within 15 minutes.
errors.LOCKED: The account is temporarily locked after too many failed sign-in attempts. Try again in 15 minutes, or ask an administrator to unlock it.
errors.INACTIVE: Your account has been deactivated. Contact your organisation's administrator.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many sign-in attempts in one minute. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.EXPIRED: Sign-in could not be completed. Sign in again with your email and password.

verify.title: Two-step verification
verify.description: Enter the six-digit code from the authenticator app on your phone.
verify.codeHint: If your phone is not available, enter one of your backup codes.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Enter a six-digit code or a backup code.
errors.INVALID_CODE: The code is incorrect or has already been used. Wait for the next code in your authenticator app and try again.
errors.LOCKED: The account is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes, or ask an administrator to unlock it.
errors.EXPIRED: Verification timed out. Sign in again with your email and password.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts in one minute. Wait a moment and try again.

account.name: Name
account.noRoles: No roles yet. Contact your organisation's administrator.
account.mustChangePassword: You signed in with a temporary password. Change your password before continuing.
account.totpRequired: Your role requires two-step verification. Turn it on before continuing.

password.title: Change password
password.hint: At least 12 characters. Use a phrase you can remember but others cannot guess.
password.success: Your password has been changed. Sessions on other devices have been ended.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Fill in all three password fields.
errors.MISMATCH: The repeated new password does not match. Type both fields again.
errors.WEAK_PASSWORD: The new password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.SAME_PASSWORD: The new password must differ from the current password.
errors.EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Reload the page and sign in again.

security.title: Two-step verification
security.intro: Two-step verification protects your account. In addition to your password, you enter a code from an authenticator app on your phone each time you sign in.
security.enabled: Two-step verification has been on since {date}.
security.step1: Install an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
security.step2: Scan the QR code below with that app.
security.manualKey: If you cannot scan it, enter this key manually:
security.step3: Enter the six-digit code shown in the app.
security.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
security.backupIntro: Store these ten codes somewhere safe. Each code can be used once to sign in when your phone is not available. They will not be shown again.
security.regenerateIntro: Once new codes are created, all old backup codes stop working. Enter a code from your authenticator app to continue.
security.successRegenerated: New backup codes have been created.

errors.INVALID_INPUT: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
errors.INVALID_CODE: The code is incorrect. Make sure your phone's clock is accurate, then enter the code currently shown.
errors.NOT_STARTED: Reload the page to start setup.
errors.EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Reload the page and sign in again.
